harness.command_notes: Run each candidate.command from harness.cwd with ACX_EVAL_LIVE=1 and GOLDEN_IMAGES_DIR set. --out paths are relative to that cwd and resolve to repo-root docs/tasks/vlm/ via ../../docs/tasks/vlm/.

candidates.command: ACX_EVAL_LIVE=1 GOLDEN_IMAGES_DIR=<golden> uv run python -m scripts.eval_harness.bakeoff --endpoint http://acx-gpu-burst:8000 --model-id Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct --model-version Q4_K_M --no-think --out ../../docs/tasks/vlm/VLM-3-bakeoff-Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-run-record.json

candidates.notes: HF id Kimi-VL-A3B-2506 is the Thinking-2506 refresh (Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506), not the original non-thinking Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct.
